post.originalText:
I tried making the classic game Romance of the Three Kingdoms using Opus 5.5 😁

People have been trying things like this for a while now, but I’d only ever watched from afar—this was my first time actually trying it myself. It whipped it up crazy fast with just a single prompt:

"Make a game like Romance of the Three Kingdoms III with a retro, pixelated classic vibe."

#claude #Opus
